output_list.criticism: The vulnerability allows the owner to mint tokens without any checks, potentially leading to uncontrolled token issuance.
The vulnerability could lead to incorrect balance updates if the transfer value is not properly validated.
Similar to transfer, this vulnerability can cause incorrect balance updates if the transfer amount is not checked.
The vulnerability allows the owner to burn tokens arbitrarily, which could lead to a denial of service for users.
The function allows the owner to set prices which could make the token unusable if set incorrectly.
